Ben — thanks for the doc. Quick answers below and some constraints from our side: 

- Legal entity: Medilabs, Inc (US). Will need W-9 and standard MPO paperwork.
- Approval bands: procurement can approve up to $150k ARR; anything above requires CFO sign-off (Tom is cc'd).
- Security: SOC2 type II and a data flow diagram would help. We also need confirmation that the private deployment will not persist PHI outside our VPC (we can share a redacted diagram).

Tom — can you confirm the CFO lane for this pilot? Our target spend is likely to fall in the $180k-$240k range depending on term.

We prefer a 12-month window if possible; procurement can sign quicker on pre-approved templates. If a 24-month deal is needed, we'll have to route to finance.

I accepted the 10am PT slot on Wednesday. Looking forward to the MAP.
